# Law360 covers Burford's investment in Kindleworth


- Law firm equity


September 9, 2025


-
-
-

*Law360* discusses Burford's investment in Kindleworth to support innovative law firm launches in the UK and US. Chief Development Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) explains that for Burford, this investment is "expanding how we deploy capital, supporting innovation, and creating value beyond traditional legal finance."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law360.com/articles/2385712/burford-invests-in-kindleworth-to-back-law-firm-launches)
